methodologyNotes: Roster covers the major x86 PC-class handheld gaming devices shipping as of mid-2026: Steam Deck OLED, Asus ROG Ally (Z1 Extreme, 2023), Asus ROG Ally X, Lenovo Legion Go, Lenovo Legion Go S, MSI Claw 8 AI+, AYANEO 2S, GPD Win 4 (2023), and AYANEO Flip KB. Sources consulted include official manufacturer product and spec pages (steamdeck.com, rog.asus.com, msi.com, ayaneo.co/com, gpdstore.net/notebookcheck, lenovo.com/PSREF), Wikipedia hardware articles, and independent editorial reviews from Tom's Hardware, PC Gamer, Notebookcheck, TechRadar, PCGuide, and VideoCardz. priceUsd reflects base/launch US MSRP as published; where manufacturers raised prices (Valve) the current published price is used and noted. Adversarial re-verification (2026-06-15) corrected: Legion Go S ram_gb and priceNote ($729.99 launch config is Z2 Go 32GB/1TB, not 16GB/512GB), AYANEO Flip KB battery_wh (45 not 46.2 per Notebookcheck measured spec), and AYANEO 2S priceNote (the $1,139.99 figure is the retail preorder STARTING price per MiniXPC; the 16GB/512GB base was $949 early-bird). Weight is listed in grams for the primary body (controllers detached where applicable); screen size in inches; battery in Wh. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Valve Steam Deck OLED
products.priceNote: Current MSRP 512GB model (raised from $549 to $789 effective 27 May 2026; 1TB now $949)
products.provenance: Specs (7.4-in OLED, 1280x800, 90 Hz, 50 Wh, 16 GB RAM, 640 g) confirmed from the official Valve tech specs page. Chip identified as AMD 'Sephiroth' 6nm die-shrink APU (Zen 2 / RDNA 2, same config as original Deck) via VideoCardz and Notebookcheck. Price $789 (512GB) confirmed per Tom's Hardware coverage of the 27 May 2026 Valve price increase; 1TB now $949. No corrections required.

products.name: Asus ROG Ally (Z1 Extreme)
products.provenance: Confirmed via official ASUS ROG US spec page and Wikipedia. Release date June 13, 2023 and launch price $699.99 verified. Battery 40 Wh, 7-inch 1080p variable-refresh up to 120 Hz LCD, 16 GB LPDDR5, AMD Ryzen Z1 Extreme (Zen 4 / RDNA 3 12CU). Weight 608 g per ASUS/Tom's Hardware. No corrections required.

products.name: Asus ROG Ally X
products.provenance: Confirmed from the official ASUS ROG spec page and VideoCardz launch coverage. Launch price $799.99, 80 Wh battery (2x the 2023 model), 24 GB LPDDR5X-7500 RAM, 1TB storage, 678 g, Full HD 120 Hz. Release July 2024. No corrections required.

products.name: Lenovo Legion Go
products.provenance: Confirmed: 8.8-in QHD+ (2560x1600) 144 Hz, 49.2 Wh, 16 GB LPDDR5X, 854 g with detachable controllers (650 g body only), AMD Ryzen Z1 Extreme. Release October 2023. Launch price $699.99 for the Z1 Extreme 512GB config. No corrections required.

products.name: Lenovo Legion Go S
products.priceNote: Windows launch MSRP (14 Feb 2025) for the Z2 Go 32GB/1TB config; cheaper Windows configs (16GB/512GB from $599) and a SteamOS variant ($499-$549) followed in 2025
products.provenance: CORRECTED. 8-in 1920x1200 IPS 120 Hz, 55.5 Wh (confirmed via Lenovo PSREF spec sheet), 740 g, AMD Ryzen Z2 Go (Zen 3+ 4c/8t, RDNA 2 12CU, Lenovo-exclusive). US release Feb 14, 2025. The $729.99 LAUNCH config is 32GB RAM / 1TB SSD (per Tom's Hardware and TechRadar) — the draft incorrectly labeled it 16GB/512GB and listed ram_gb 16; both fixed (ram_gb 16->32, priceNote rewritten). The 16GB/512GB Windows config arrived later at $599; SteamOS variants at $499-$549.
